name: CAN Foundation Project Eklavya Scholarship (NLU students)
provider: Confederation of Alumni for National Law Universities (CAN Foundation)

value: 3-year LL.B. at a National Law University
rules.quote: Students must be enrolled in 5-year Integrated or 3-year LL.B. programmes at any National Law University.
An average of 70% aggregate marks in the last three semesters.
Annual cumulative family income below ₹8 Lakhs (of Father, Mother, unmarried Brother, and/or unmarried Sister) in the last 3 Financial Years.
A minimum of 75% attendance in the last three semesters.
First-year students (Batch of 2026-2031 or 2026-2029) are not eligible to apply.

amount.text: Annual scholarships; 2024-25: 48 scholars from 18 NLUs, INR 46 lakh total (per-scholar amount not stated)
amount.quote: the Foundation granted Scholarships to 48 Scholars from 18 NLUs across the nation, amounting to INR 46 Lakhs.

documents.name: Notarised affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper
documents.quote: Duly notarised affidavit on ₹100/- Non-Judicial Stamp Paper.

documents.name: Vice-Chancellor recommendation letter
documents.quote: Personalised Letter of Recommendation of the Vice-Chancellor (with University's Account Number and PAN)

deadline.text: Deadline to apply for Eklavya 2026-27 is 11th September 2026
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply for Eklavya 2026-27 is 11th September 2026.
